metadata.title: UAE ground stability classification zones — Phase 1 v0.1 derived layer
metadata.data_origin: DERIVED from subsidence_velocity.geojson (Layer 1) per the threshold schema below. Currently a SEED layer — only the Remah bowl is real-data; remaining geometry awaits full PS-InSAR pipeline output.
metadata.derivation_logic: Take subsidence_velocity.geojson points → bin by stability_class → either (a) buffer + dissolve points to polygon hulls per class, or (b) interpolate to raster + threshold. v0.1 ships pre-built representative polygons for the Remah CRITICAL zone only.

properties.note: Approximate hull around the documented Remah subsidence bowl. Polygon is APPROXIMATE — replace with PS-InSAR-derived hull in v0.2.
